text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day leading up to the Takarazuka Kinen, Admire Vega and Meisho Doto go to watch the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O, with otherworldly presence, declares the beginning of a new chapter to the fierce competition there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After her incredible performance in the race, she addresses Meisho Doto in the audience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for you and you alone, she shouts. It seems this is the last push Meisho Doto needed to finally break out of her shell.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto heads off for training. Seeing her inspires Admire Vega to begin running herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At last, all four of them are ready. Surely this is a sign that their senior year will be filled with excitement.
